exercises.instruction: What do you say to Sam? Use I think so, I hope not etc.

items.prompt: (You don't like rain.) SaM: Is it going to rain? (hope)
(You need more money.) SaM: Do you think you'll get a pay rise? (hope)
(You're going to a party. You can't stand John.) SaM: Will John be at the party? (hope)
(You're not sure whether Amy is married, but she probably isn't.) SaM: Is Amy married? (think)
(Jane has lived in Italy for many years.) SaM: Does Jane speak Italian? (suppose)
(You have to leave Sam's party early.) SaM: Do you have to leave already? (afraid)
(You're not sure what time the film begins, but it's probably 7.30.) SaM: What time is the film? 7.30? (think)
(You are the receptionist at a hotel. The hotel is full.) SaM: Do you have a room for tonight? (afraid)
